_about: English keys awaiting translation into the 19 enabled non-English catalogs (Playbook 132.4 handoff). Written by tools/localization_handoff.py; read by tools/validate_localization.py.

KEEP_LINE_ALL_UPGRADES.en: Every upgrade you bought, with Coins or Gems (a camp's own upgrades work again once you buy that camp again)

KEEP_LINE_MERGES.en: Merge levels of every weapon, outfit and skill, restored when you find that item again

KEEP_LINE_MAIN_OBJECTIVES.en: Main objectives you completed but have not claimed yet

RESET_LINE_CARRIED_ITEMS.en: Every item you carry (weapons, outfits, skills and supplies) and its random bonus attributes

RESET_LINE_RUN_PROGRESS.en: Unfinished Prestige opportunities. Pending offline Coins and Gems are paid first; unclaimed offline item copies are lost.

PRESTIGE_KEEP_ALL.en: Cards and sets, your Coins and Gems, every upgrade you bought with Coins or Gems, the merge level of every weapon, outfit and skill, explored map areas, player level and XP, boss keys, enemy achievements, Map Mastery, unclaimed main objectives and settings.

PRESTIGE_RESET_RUN.en: Every item you carry (supplies included) and its random bonus attributes, map access (back to Winter I), owned camps and unfinished Prestige opportunities.

LEGACY_ITEM_EXPLAIN.en: An old-stat copy from before the weapon update. It keeps its power until your next Prestige, then leaves with your items. New copies of this weapon use the new stats and keep your merge level.

EVOLUTION_RULE.en: At ^%d, spend %d spare copies for one copy of the next-tier weapon (%d copies in all). This weapon keeps its merge level and one copy; the new weapon uses its own merge level. A target stack or empty slot is required.

FOLLOW_MASTERWORK_ANY_GEAR.en: Merge an outfit, skill or Obsidian weapon to ^100: best ^%d/^100

FOLLOW_MASTERWORK_TIER_GEAR.en: Merge a tier %d+ outfit, skill or Obsidian weapon to ^100: best ^%d/^100

FOLLOW_ARSENAL_SPLIT_T2.en: Tier 2+ weapons at ^20: %d/%d · tier 2+ outfits at ^50: %d/%d

CONTENT_MASTERWORK_O1_RULE.en: Merge any outfit, skill or Obsidian weapon to ^100

CONTENT_MASTERWORK_O2_RULE.en: Merge a tier 2 or higher outfit, skill or Obsidian weapon to ^100

CONTENT_MASTERWORK_O3_RULE.en: Merge a tier 3 or higher outfit, skill or Obsidian weapon to ^100

CONTENT_ARSENAL_O1_RULE.en: Merge one weapon to ^20 and one outfit to ^50

CONTENT_ARSENAL_O2_RULE.en: Merge 3 different weapons to ^20 and 3 different outfits to ^50

CONTENT_ARSENAL_O3_RULE.en: Merge 3 different tier 2+ weapons to ^20 and 3 different tier 2+ outfits to ^50

MERGE_AT_CAP.en: This item is at its merge cap.

EVOLUTION_NEEDS_COPIES.en: Evolution needs the full merge level and enough spare copies.

AUTO_EVOLVE_BENEFIT.en: Evolves at ^20 with 10 spare copies (31 in all): %s

MAIN_HINT_9.en: Evolve a ^20 weapon that has 10 spare copies (item details, Evolve)

MASTERY_FORGE_RULE.en: Outfits from here to ^%s (boss outfits ^%s) and one weapon from here evolved (Spring maps: an Obsidian weapon from here at ^20).

ITEM_ENHANCED.en: Boss weapon: two bonus attributes added

ITEM_BOSS_BONUS_EXPLAIN.en: Boss-enhanced: your first copy of this weapon from a boss added two bonus attributes. Later boss copies count as normal copies. Bonus attributes reset at Prestige; merge levels stay.

ITEM_BOSS_BONUS_HINT.en: The first copy of this weapon you get from a boss adds two bonus attributes (once per run).

REROLL_ATTRIBUTE_CONFIRM.en: Spend %s gems to reroll %s? The new roll replaces this attribute, even if weaker. Your other attributes stay as they are.

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: On Winter II, in order, defeat 50 of each: Wolf Hood, Calico Cat Hood, Golden Crown, Reindeer Antlers, Santa Hat, Space Helmet

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_O5_DESCRIPTION.en: On Summer II, in order, defeat 60 of each: Cowboy Bandana, Duck Swim Ring, Rainbow Clown, Red Cap Swimmer, Snorkeler, Straw Hat Swimmer

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_O6_DESCRIPTION.en: On Autumn I, in order, defeat 120 of each: Black Cap, Mushroom Cap, Pumpkin Head

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_O7_DESCRIPTION.en: On Autumn II, in order, defeat 100 of each: Horned Hood, Orange Screen Helmet, Television Head, Top Hat

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_O8_DESCRIPTION.en: On Spring II, in order, defeat 60 of each: Flower Crown, Green Cap, Pink Cap, Pink Flower Hood, Plain, Sprout

CONTENT_COLLECTION_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: Pick up 16 each of the Santa Hat, Reindeer Antlers and Space Helmet outfits (Winter II drops). Submit hands in 15 of each and you keep one

CONTENT_COLLECTION_O5_DESCRIPTION.en: Pick up 26 each of the Snorkeler, Red Cap Swimmer and Straw Hat Swimmer outfits (Summer II drops). Submit hands in 25 of each and you keep one

CONTENT_COLLECTION_O6_DESCRIPTION.en: Pick up 31 each of the Black Cap, Mushroom Cap and Pumpkin Head outfits (Autumn I drops). Submit hands in 30 of each and you keep one

CONTENT_COLLECTION_O7_DESCRIPTION.en: Pick up 31 each of the Television Head, Top Hat and Orange Screen Helmet outfits (Autumn II drops). Submit hands in 30 of each and you keep one

CONTENT_COLLECTION_O8_DESCRIPTION.en: Pick up 41 each of the Pink Cap, Plain and Sprout outfits (Spring II drops). Submit hands in 40 of each and you keep one

CONTENT_HUNTER_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: Defeat the Bee and the Orange Tabby Cat (Spring I bosses) 10 times each

CONTENT_CHALLENGE_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: Defeat the Red Panda (Spring II boss) without using any supply during the fight

CONTENT_TROPHY_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: After finding this, defeat the Bee, the Orange Tabby Cat (Spring I), the Red Panda and the Sunflower (Spring II) once each

CONTENT_REGIONAL_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: On Autumn I and Autumn II: explore 90% of each map, defeat all four bosses and unlock every camp

CONTENT_MASTERWORK_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: Merge an Obsidian weapon (Spring I and Spring II drops) to ^100

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: -4% damage taken for each normal enemy attacking you beyond the first (up to -20%)

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_C5_DESCRIPTION.en: When you drop below 30% HP, heal 25% of your maximum HP (once every 90 s)

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_C6_DESCRIPTION.en: Basic attacks also deal 10% damage to other enemies close to your target
CONTENT_EXPEDITION_C6_DESCRIPTION.note: Cleave 30% -> 10%. Non-English catalogs were deliberately left unchanged in Change 60 and still say 30% (es-419, es-ES, pt-BR, fr-FR, de-DE translated it; the other 14 show English until delivered); all 19 need this key in the next localization pass.

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_C7_DESCRIPTION.en: Enemies called into a group fight start attacking 0.5 s later

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_C8_DESCRIPTION.en: Out of combat away from camps, you recover HP three times as fast

CONTENT_COLLECTION_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: Weapons and outfits dropped by normal enemies have a 10% chance to be 2 copies

CONTENT_COLLECTION_C5_DESCRIPTION.en: Evolution needs 8 spare copies instead of 10

CONTENT_COLLECTION_C7_DESCRIPTION.en: Rerolls cost 25% fewer gems and never return the same stat

CONTENT_COLLECTION_C8_DESCRIPTION.en: Boss bonus attributes roll in the upper half of their range

CONTENT_HUNTER_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: Boss skill warnings last 0.3 s longer and boss heals restore 25% less

CONTENT_TROPHY_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: Defeating a boss for the first time in a run rolls its loot twice

CONTENT_REGIONAL_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: +25% XP from normal enemies on maps before your furthest unlocked map

CONTENT_MASTERWORK_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: +15% stats gained from every Obsidian weapon merge

FOLLOW_MASTERWORK_OBSIDIAN.en: Merge an Obsidian weapon to ^100: best ^%d/^100

MAP_MARKERS_HINT.en: Enemies and bosses you have found can be marked on this map. Buy Map Detail in Map upgrades below: it stays bought after Prestige.

MAP_DETAIL_NEXT_1.en: Next: markers for the enemies and bosses you have found

MAP_DETAIL_NEXT_2.en: Next: enemy names; tap a marker to inspect it

OFFLINE_GEAR_HINT.en: While you are away you can also receive copies of weapons and outfits you already own. Unlock it in Upgrades → Offline.

OFFLINE_GEAR_BENEFIT.en: Off → On · copies of gear you own, about 1 per hour

EVOLVE_READY_HINT.en: %s is fully merged. Collect %d more copies to evolve it into %s.

GUIDE_GEAR_BONUS_DETAIL.en: Equipped weapons and outfits give 100% of their stats. Stored weapons still give 30%, and stored outfits give 15%. Tap your level bar, then Stats, to see how your gear helps you.

GUIDE_GEAR_BONUS_OPEN_DETAIL.en: Stats lists everything that makes your hero stronger.

GUIDE_GEAR_BONUS_STATS_DETAIL.en: This line shows the share stored gear gives. Close Stats to continue.

GUIDE_OFFLINE_REWARDS_DETAIL.en: You earn Coins and Gems while offline. In Upgrades → Offline, you can also unlock Weapons, Outfits and Supplies from items you own, then improve their reward rates. Take a look; you don't need to buy anything now.

GUIDE_RESPAWN_SELECT_DETAIL.en: Open World and choose your newly unlocked camp. This is where you'll return after being defeated.

GUIDE_RESPAWN_SELECT_TAP_DETAIL.en: Select your newly unlocked camp. This is where you'll return after being defeated.

GUIDE_CAMP_TRAVEL_DETAIL.en: You now have two unlocked camps in Winter I. Open World, choose a different camp and tap Travel. Traveling does not change your selected respawn camp.

GUIDE_CAMP_TRAVEL_TAP_DETAIL.en: Travel to your other camp. Traveling does not change your selected respawn camp.

GUIDE_CAMP_TRAVEL_WAIT_DETAIL.en: You can't travel during combat. Step away from enemies, then travel to your other camp.

GUIDE_BOSS_FOUND_DETAIL.en: Finding a boss unlocks Prestige opportunities. First, let's make the World map more useful. Open World.

GUIDE_MAP_DETAILS_DETAIL.en: In Map upgrades, buy the first Map detail rank. It reveals enemy and boss markers for places you've discovered.

GUIDE_MAP_DETAILS_EARN_DETAIL.en: %s more Coins needed. Keep defeating enemies.

GUIDE_ENEMY_PINS_DETAIL.en: Open World and look for the new enemy markers. Use them to find places to farm.

GUIDE_ENEMY_PINS_TAP_DETAIL.en: Markers show enemies you've discovered. Use them to find places to farm.

GUIDE_ENEMY_PINS_EXPLORE_DETAIL.en: Markers appear only for enemies you've discovered. Walk into the fog to find more.

GUIDE_HUNT_FOLLOW_DETAIL.en: A mission to defeat 30 enemies is now available. Open Missions and tap Follow to pin its progress to your screen. Any enemy counts.

GUIDE_HUNT_FARM_DETAIL.en: Farm any enemies you can beat. Check their locations using the markers on your World map. Follow your mission's progress until it reaches 30/30.

GUIDE_HUNT_CLAIM_DETAIL.en: Your 30-enemy mission is complete! Open Missions and tap Claim.

GUIDE_BOSS_PRESTIGE_FOLLOW_DETAIL.en: Open Prestige and follow the Snowman opportunity. Defeat the Snowman once to complete it.

GUIDE_BOSS_WIN.en: Get stronger, then defeat the Snowman.

GUIDE_BOSS_WIN_DETAIL.en: The Snowman may be too strong now. Keep farming, merging equipment and buying upgrades until you can win. Your followed Prestige opportunity will update when you defeat it.

GUIDE_WORLD_OPEN_DETAIL.en: Winter II is unlocked. Open World to choose your next stage.

GUIDE_WINTER_TWO_TRAVEL_DETAIL.en: Select Winter II and travel to its arrival camp.

GUIDE_PRESTIGE_OPTIONAL_DETAIL.en: You've completed your first Prestige opportunity. You can Prestige now, or keep playing and complete more opportunities to redeem together in one reset. Open Prestige to see your choices; you don't have to reset.

GUIDE_PRESTIGE_OPTIONAL_PANEL_DETAIL.en: Your Snowman opportunity is ready. Prestige now, or close this panel and keep playing to collect more opportunities first.

MAP_MARKER_RANK1.en: You've found enemies here. Map detail rank 2 shows who they are.

STATS_STORED_EXPLAIN.en: Equipped weapons and outfits give 100%% of their stats. Gear you only store still helps: weapons give %s%% and outfits %s%%. The HP and Damage breakdowns below show what your stored gear adds.

OFFLINE_TAB_EXPLAIN.en: Coins and Gems build up while you're away. Unlock Weapons, Outfits and Supplies below to also receive copies of items you own, then raise their reward rates. Nothing here is required.

OFFLINE_ITEMS_HINT.en: While you're away you can also receive copies of weapons, outfits and supplies you own. Unlock them in Upgrades → Offline.

CONTENT_HUNTER_O1_FIRST_DESCRIPTION.en: Defeat the Snowman (Winter I boss) once

PRESTIGE_LOCKED_BOSS_DEFEAT.en: Defeat the Winter I Snowman (the first boss) once to unlock the Prestige reset.

PRESTIGE_REQ_BOSS_DEFEAT.en: Defeat the Winter I Snowman (first boss) once

GUIDE_BASIC_PRESTIGE_DEFEAT_DETAIL.en: Finding the Winter I Snowman opens Prestige and its first opportunity; defeating it once unlocks the reset. Complete opportunities, then Prestige when you choose to restart with permanent cards. Map Mastery tracks each map's long-term goals.

GUIDE_PRESTIGE_OPTIONAL_CLOSE_DETAIL.en: You can Prestige now to claim your ready opportunities, or keep playing to earn more and redeem them together. To continue without resetting, tap Close.

GUIDE_GEAR_BONUS_CLOSE_DETAIL.en: The Stored gear counts line shows the share your stored weapons and outfits give. Tap Close to continue.

TELEPORT_MAP_HELP.en: Tap a green camp to select it, then Confirm Teleport. Blue marks where you are.

TELEPORT_STAGE_NONE.en: You have no other camp on this map. Choose another map above.

TELEPORT_CAMP_LOCKED.en: This camp is locked. Unlock it at the camp to teleport there.

OFFLINE_LOCKED_EXPLAIN.en: Unlock Offline upgrades to earn weapons, outfits, and supplies while away. Unlocks apply to future time away only. Go to Upgrades claims these rewards first.

FOCUS_LOCKED_GLOBAL.en: Buy Focused Farming once in Player Upgrades to farm any discovered enemy.

FOCUS_GLOBAL_BENEFIT.en: Select an enemy to farm automatically. If your hero dies, they'll return to that enemy and continue farming after respawning.

FOCUS_GLOBAL_OWNED.en: Owned: tap Farm on any discovered enemy.

HELP_LANDING_INTRO.en: Pick a topic or read every guide in order. Reading changes nothing in your game.

HELP_DISCOVERY_BASIC.en: Want more help? Open Settings → Help & Tutorials. Pick a topic or read all 14 guides.

HELP_DISCOVERY_GUIDED.en: Need a reminder later? Open Settings → Help & Tutorials for a guide to every system.

HELP_DISCOVERY_CHOOSER.en: You can explore Help & Tutorials anytime in Settings.

HELP_CARD_MOVEMENT_COMBAT_ACTION.en: Drag the joystick to approach an enemy.

HELP_CARD_MOVEMENT_COMBAT_SUPPORT.en: Your hero automatically attacks enemies within reach.

HELP_CARD_MANUAL_TARGET_ACTION.en: Drag from your hero to an enemy, then release.

HELP_CARD_MANUAL_TARGET_SUPPORT.en: Use this gesture to change who your hero attacks.

HELP_CARD_COLLECT_EQUIP_ACTION.en: Collect dropped gear, then equip it.

HELP_CARD_COLLECT_EQUIP_SUPPORT.en: Equipment strengthens you; stored gear also grants bonuses.

HELP_CARD_MERGE_GEAR_ACTION.en: Merge two copies of the same item.

HELP_CARD_MERGE_GEAR_SUPPORT.en: Merging increases the item's strength and merge rank.

HELP_CARD_PLAYER_UPGRADES_ACTION.en: Buy upgrades to strengthen your hero.

HELP_CARD_PLAYER_UPGRADES_SUPPORT.en: Focused Farming unlocks globally for 25 Gems here.

HELP_CARD_ENEMY_AUTOMATION_ACTION.en: Upgrade each enemy type to automate its loot.

HELP_CARD_ENEMY_AUTOMATION_SUPPORT.en: Auto-Collect, Auto-Merge and Auto-Evolution are type-specific.

HELP_CARD_MISSIONS_ACTION.en: Follow a mission and claim its completed reward.

HELP_CARD_MISSIONS_SUPPORT.en: Missions give you goals and additional resources.

HELP_CARD_EXPLORE_CAMPS_ACTION.en: Discover camps, then select your destination on the map.

HELP_CARD_EXPLORE_CAMPS_SUPPORT.en: Unlock camps to travel and choose where you respawn.

HELP_CARD_SKILLS_SUPPLIES_ACTION.en: Equip skills and supplies before tougher fights.

HELP_CARD_SKILLS_SUPPLIES_SUPPORT.en: Skills assist combat; supplies can heal or grant boosts.

HELP_CARD_OFFLINE_REWARDS_ACTION.en: Claim rewards when you return to the game.

HELP_CARD_OFFLINE_REWARDS_SUPPORT.en: Offline upgrades unlock more reward categories.

HELP_CARD_WEAPON_EVOLUTION_ACTION.en: Meet the merge and copy requirements to evolve a weapon.

HELP_CARD_WEAPON_EVOLUTION_SUPPORT.en: Evolution advances a weapon to a stronger tier.

HELP_CARD_PRESTIGE_ACTION.en: Defeat the Snowman and complete Prestige opportunities.

HELP_CARD_PRESTIGE_SUPPORT.en: Prestige grants permanent cards when you reset your run.

HELP_CARD_MAP_DETAILS_MASTERY_ACTION.en: Explore maps and purchase Map Details to learn more.

HELP_CARD_MAP_DETAILS_MASTERY_SUPPORT.en: Map Mastery: each map's Explore, Hunt, Research, Collect and Forge goals earn permanent rewards.

HELP_CARD_ADVANCED_FARMING_ACTION.en: Choose a discovered spot and tap Farm.

HELP_CARD_ADVANCED_FARMING_SUPPORT.en: After a respawn, your hero returns to that enemy and keeps farming. Move manually to stop.

GUIDE_TARGET_STRIKE_DETAIL.en: Your hero walks to the enemy you chose and attacks it.

GUIDE_AUTO_ATTACK_DETAIL.en: Your hero now attacks nearby enemies automatically. Drag from your hero to an enemy whenever you want to change targets.

ACHIEVEMENT_DAMAGE_REWARD.en: Each milestone: +%.0f%% damage against this enemy type

GUIDE_MAP_MASTERY_DETAIL.en: Every map has Mastery goals with permanent rewards. Tap the Mastery button on the map to see this map's goals.

GUIDE_MAP_MASTERY_WORLD_DETAIL.en: Map Mastery is also in World. Tap it to see every map's goals and permanent rewards.

GUIDE_MAP_MASTERY_DETAILS_DETAIL.en: Each map shows its Mastery progress and permanent reward. Tap Details to see its five goals.

GUIDE_MAP_MASTERY_CLOSE_DETAIL.en: Explore, Hunt, Research, Collect and Forge: each card shows its progress and what remains. Complete all five for this map's permanent reward. No rush: tap Close to keep playing.

STAT_CAPS_NOTE_NO_CRIT.en: Totals above include caps: lifesteal 15%, attack speed bonus 200%. Critical chance and critical damage have no cap; at 100% chance every hit is critical.

FOCUS_HINT_PANEL_WALK.en: Tap Farm below: your hero walks to this spot and fights here by itself. Tap again to stop. Walking by hand for 5 seconds also stops it.

GUIDE_FOCUS_TAP_WALK_DETAIL.en: Your hero walks to this spot and fights it by itself. Walking by hand for 5 seconds stops it.

GUIDE_FOCUS_QUICK_DETAIL.en: Your hero farms this enemy by itself. Tap again to stop; walking by hand for 5 seconds also stops it.

HELP_CARD_ADVANCED_FARMING_ACTION_V69.en: Near a discovered enemy, tap Auto Farm (or Farm in its Upgrades).

HELP_CARD_ADVANCED_FARMING_SUPPORT_V69.en: Respawns return to it. Walking by hand 5 seconds stops it; let go sooner to keep farming.

FILTERS_HINT_V71.en: These choices organize your main inventory and stay until you change them. All and Default show every item in slot order.

KEEP_LINE_SUPPLY_MASTERY.en: Supply Mastery and its use progress, and your daily missions (progress and claims)

SUPPLY_MASTERY_EXPLAIN.en: Every 5 uses of a supply raise its mastery by one level, up to ^%d. Buying or finding supplies adds stock only. Prestige keeps mastery levels and use progress.

SUPPLY_NO_MERGE.en: Every five uses raise Supply Mastery. Prestige keeps mastery and use progress.

MERGE_ALL_LOCKED_HINT.en: Merge All: unlock it once for 500 gems in Upgrades → Inventory.
